name: Olongapo
summary: First-party English and Filipino-oriented discovery evidenced the Olongapo City Assessor, City Planning GIS-map procedure, and DENR-LMB cadastral custody. The current public Geoportal LMB parcel layer is queryable but explicitly covers selected Metro Manila areas, not Olongapo; the bounded exact-point query returned zero features and no geometry was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, viewer/configuration inspection, schema/CRS findings, statuses, extent evidence, authorization result, and exact-point WMS response are recorded in city-1812-olongapo.json.
custodians: City Planning and Development Office, Olongapo

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: denr_parcel_data; public layer config lists ogc_fid, wkb_geometry, lotnumber, shape_length, shape_area
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdField: ogc_fid observed but not qualified as a stable Olongapo native identity

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [14.8411590537445, 120.291028714876] was preserved and not moved.
The published Geoportal parcel extent is Metro Manila and excludes Olongapo.
The zero-feature exact-point query is an extent/service miss, not evidence of citywide absence.
No Olongapo citywide public vector coverage or safe native identity was qualified.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: Registry custody is evidenced and a national public parcel layer is live, but it does not cover Olongapo and no Olongapo-scoped anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

uncertainty: Local and national custodians may hold Olongapo cadastral maps or request-based files, but the current open machine-readable source and native identity semantics remain unresolved.
artifactsNotWritten: no GeoJSON sample; no verified Olongapo parcel polygon
